name: The Scarecrow Knight
source:
A few hundred years before the events of Red-Handed Robin, a strange traveler and his adopted daughter unravel a mystery about the ancient curse of witchcraft.

[From [url=https://hollowmend.itch.io/the-scarecrow-knight]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在《Red-Handed Robin》的事件数百年前。一位神秘旅人与他的养女揭开了古老巫术诅咒背后的谜团。

[来源：[url=https://hollowmend.itch.io/the-scarecrow-knight]Itch.io[/url]]
